protocol.title: Prospective epoch-disjoint forward-skill evaluation of the clean-origin TEP network prior
protocol.training_grams: clean-origin: member Grams rebuilt on the full 2-h fit half of each member window; member target epochs end strictly before that member's holdout; zero overlap with any scored epoch at any seal lead
protocol.penalty_selection: causal holdout-Gram lambda selection at seal time (validation set available at seal time, in the scored positive-horizon regime); identical to the rule committed in step_174_sealed_envelope_prediction.json that produced +2.57% (22/24, CI [+1.42,+3.85], p=1.8e-5)
protocol.scored_arm: untapered pure TEP correction vs persistence (step_174b arm; taper removed because it damps the regime where the forward map is strongest)
protocol.scored_data: every data/ppp_live/results/raw_window_*.pkl archived after the commitment UTC; each window scored only at leads strictly posterior to its seal's last training window
metrics: strict-future slice (epochs with zero training coverage)
protocol.falsification_rule: report all values regardless of sign; mean pure improvement <= 0 on >= 30 epoch-disjoint windows refutes the forward component at the deployed cadence
protocol.integrity: envelopes SHA-256-sealed, anchor-chained SHA256(prev + weights_sha256 + utc); chain head committed to public repository history = externally verifiable timestamp

note: spec body hashed verbatim (canonical JSON); scoring against this commitment is prospective from committed_utc
